Huge for Tesla Europe


Esther Rebers (@EstherRebers)

Breaking:

Today, July 21, 2026, @Tesla began rolling out Grok in the Netherlands. The AI ​​assistant is included in Tesla’s Summer Release software update, the free rollout of which to eligible vehicles has commenced.

Integrated into a Tesla, Grok can provide navigation instructions at the driver's request—whether setting a destination, adjusting routes on the fly, or discovering points of interest. Beyond navigation, Grok enables hands-free calling, allows drivers to search for their favorite songs or podcasts using the media search function, and adjusts the vehicle's climate control. Grok can also consult the vehicle's owner's manual and provide expert advice on vehicle operation, optimal usage, maintenance, and the interpretation of dashboard warnings.

Grok is currently being rolled out and is available on eligible versions of the Model S, Model 3, Model X, and Model Y. To activate and use Grok, users must have a Premium Connectivity subscription or a stable Wi-Fi connection. Conversations are anonymous to Tesla and not linked to the vehicle, ensuring owner privacy.
Amazing news for all owners in The Netherlands!🇳🇱

GROK 4.5 DOMINATES ON EFFICIENCY WHILE STAYING COMPETITIVE AT THE FRONTIER

Grok 4.5 continues to stand out for its exceptional cost efficiency and token usage while remaining in the top tier of frontier models.

Key highlights:
•  Significantly lower cost per task compared to Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.6, and others
•  Strong token efficiency (often using far fewer tokens for similar or better results)
•  Competitive performance across intelligence and coding benchmarks
While some models edge it out on raw benchmark scores, Grok 4.5 consistently delivers one of the best performance-to-cost ratios available right now — making it especially practical for heavy real-world usage.
xAI’s focus on building capable and efficient models is clearly paying off.
